about_the_game:
It's early July, and you're told you're a crook named Thommatt One Mangi. You've been employed by an anonymous contractor to go to President Rump's rally, and fake an assassination. You're promised a lifetime amount of eggs!

Liberals have had enough of Rump and his beautiful economy and amazing living conditions, and they want an end to it to create HELL ON EARTH. As an independent contractor, it's on you to decide if money IS the true purpose of your life. You've had back pain all your life, and have had a surgery gone wrong. Will you take your anger out by reining hell on God's Green America, or save it from the blue haired liberals that only aim to cause destruction and nothing more?

Features

20 levels to attempt to fake assassinate Rump in (with more to come)!

An economy tracker that dictates the price of things like game consoles or groceries depending on how successful you are!

Bunnyhop and surf mechanics

Lots of surf levels

Scoring system. Can you unlock the secret T**n T****s level?

No AI used!

Solo dev, but I must simply thank my country's healthcare system for making me come up with the concept of this game! Truly inspirational!

You'll like this game if:

You like CS-style surfing

You like good handling movement and speedy platforming

You enjoy political humor 

Coming soon:

Steam achievements

Steam trading cards

Extra levels (you can also make a thread on the community tab of the game to suggest level ideas, or any features in general! I enjoy creating these)

Controller support (but you should be able to get it to work using steam input. The game uses WASD, space, left/right click, R, TAB, and ESC, the last three are only used for functions like quitting or extra information)

Being able to press F to inspect your weapon and spin it around as you surf

There's a Discord server for you to share any feedback, ask questions, or simply to talk with the developer! I haven't set up any perms yet, so you can be the first person to grief it! 

NOW LET'S SAVE AMERICA AGAIN
